title.narrative: Multi-country Western Pacific Integrated HIV/TB Program - Oceania - Multicountry Western Pacific (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Multicountry Western Pacific, TB/HIV, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Pacific Office in Fiji)This program has the following goals: To support 12 Pacific Island countries in ending AIDS and tuberculosis in the post-Covid period. The objectives of this program are: To strengthen comprehensiveness and quality of HIV prevention, treatment and care service-delivery models with a view to programmatic sustainability. To provide early rapid and quality diagnosis of TB, DR-TB and comorbidities with specific focus on hard to reach, vulnerable groups across 12 Pacific Island countries. To sustain high quality treatment for all forms of TB including drug-resistant TB and HIV-related TB with patient support. To build up the resilience of healthcare systems, including community systems, to deliver integrated people-centered models of HIV and TB care
